fields.subject: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable
fields.condition: an update request's suspect list contains two or more reports from the same suspecting silo (same address bytes, port, and generation)
fields.trigger: the caller requests replacement of a membership record
fields.response: send one suspect-report row per distinct suspecting silo in the membership update query contract, keyed by its (address, port, generation) content, and for a suspector that reported more than once retain the latest (greatest) timestamp among its reports
fields.postcondition: reports from distinct suspecting silos (differing in address, port, or generation, IPv4 or IPv6) each yield their own row; repeated reports from one suspector never add rows; the retained timestamp is the suspector's most recent vote, matching Orleans' rule that a silo's re-vote replaces its earlier vote and only fresh votes count
